# WaferPulse

> Industrial MLOps platform for semiconductor wafer fault detection and root-cause analysis.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://mostlyoutlier.pages.dev/
> Live Site: https://waferpulse.pages.dev/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/WaferPulse

## Overview
WaferPulse automates semiconductor fab yield quality control by processing WM-811K wafer maps through high-accuracy computer vision and spatial defect classification models. It detects failure signatures (Center, Donut, Edge-Loc, Edge-Ring, Loc, Random, Scratch, Near-full), clusters process chamber telemetry, and attributes root causes in real-time.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.dev/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, Somnostasis, Curavex, Hajree, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Technical Capabilities
- Dataset & Preprocessing: WM-811K dataset (811,472 wafer maps) with Radon/W-transform and geometry filtering.
- Deep Learning Architecture: ResNet-18 convolutional backbone + XGBoost tabular chamber telemetry classifier.
- Root Cause Attribution: UMAP + HDBSCAN regime clustering isolating malfunctioning etch and deposition chambers.
- Model Governance: Full artifact versioning, drift detection (KS test, PSI), and Prometheus metrics export.
